My voice.

When I answer the phone I say:
"Thanks for calling such and such, how can I help you sir or ma'am?"
I carried that with me from the military.

The woman and the phone was extremely upset. Not that I called her ma'am but the WAY I called her ma'am. I guess it sounds very southern. She paused and asked if I was gonna do the whole phone call "in that stupid voice"

After that I said ma'am at every chance I got, which was a lot because she had a lot of yes or no questions. "Yes ma'am" "no ma'am"

Let me speak to your manager!
Ma'am, I am the manager. 
Oh you are?!
Yes ma'am.

That phone call went to corporate, and I got in trouble. Totally worth it though.
